content.question: What's the difference between a megabyte (MB) and a gigabyte (GB)?

stayConnected.title: Stay Connected: How to Use Yoowifi for Your Travels
introParagraphs: Imagine landing in a new city, only to realize your phone has no service. No Google Maps to guide you. No Grab or Uber to book a ride. No way to check your hotel reservation or share your first travel moments. This modern travel nightmare is all too common for globetrotters today.

The struggles of staying connected abroad go far beyond simple inconvenience. Many travelers face sky-high roaming charges, others deal with unreliable hotel WiFi, and then there are the risks of public hotspots in airports and cafes that can expose your personal data to hackers.

Whether you're a solo adventurer, a digital nomad, or a family on vacation, we have the perfect connectivity solution for you. With our range of portable internet options—pocket WiFi, SIM, eSIM, and router—staying online is easy, affordable, and most importantly, reliable.
stayConnected.whyTitle: Why Yoowifi is Your Ultimate Travel WiFi Solution
stayConnected.whyDescription: Travel confidently with a reliable connection for navigation, social media, work, and more.

whyPoints.title: No More Bill Shock
whyPoints.desc: Say goodbye to surprise roaming fees from your telco. With Yoowifi, you get transparent, fixed rates for data usage, so you can browse, stream, and share without the fear of a massive phone bill waiting back home.

whyPoints.title: Stay Connected Anywhere
whyPoints.desc: Experience seamless internet access across over 160 countries with Yoowifi. Whether you're exploring Europe, Asia, America, Africa, or Oceania, Yoowifi´s internet solutions keep you connected—no need to swap SIMs or hunt for local providers.

whyPoints.title: Connect Multiple Devices
whyPoints.desc: Traveling with family or friends? Yoowifi’s pocket WiFi lets you connect up to 6 devices at once, making it perfect for group adventures. Share one plan, save on costs for group trips, and keep everyone online for navigation, social media, or work purposes.

whyPoints.title: Private and Secure
whyPoints.desc: Don’t risk your data on unsecured public WiFi at airports or cafes. Yoowifi offers an encrypted, secure connection that protects your personal information, ensuring your online activities stay private and safe wherever you go.

whyPoints.title: Hassle-Free Setup and Use
whyPoints.desc: With Yoowifi, there’s no need to struggle with foreign SIM cards or decipher local languages. Simply activate your Yoowifi SIM, eSIM, or power on your pocket WiFi or router, and you’re instantly connected—no need to visit local stores or deal with complicated instructions. It’s a hassle-free solution that works right out of the box.

stayConnected.rentPocketTitle: How to Rent a Yoowifi Pocket Wifi
stayConnected.rentPocketDec: Are you traveling with family or friends to popular destinations like Japan, a digital nomad who loves working from beachside cafes like those in the Philippines, or a business traveler juggling meetings across time zones? If so, then consider renting our pocket WiFi for international travels. It's the ultimate travel gadget for those who crave seamless connectivity without the fuss.
stayConnected.stepBystep: Here's a step-by-step guide to renting a Yoowifi pocket wifi:
rentPocketSteps: Download the Yoowifi app (for first timers).
Choose the country or countries you'll be visiting and the rental duration.
Select the data plan that best suits your needs—whether it’s a 5GB day pass, 100GB annual plan, or unlimited data.
Pick your preferred pocket WiFi color (if available) for a personalized look.
Indicate how many devices will be connecting (up to 6 devices).
Proceed to the checkout page to verify the order, delivery method, and payment mode.
Keep an eye on your inbox for a confirmation email, and get ready to receive your device.
The pocket WiFi comes with clear instructions on how to use or operate it. Should you need any assistance, don't hesitate to contact the Yoowifi customer service team for prompt support.
stayConnected.rentRouterTitle: How to Rent a Yoowifi Router
stayConnected.rentRouterDec: Planning a trip with a small team and need reliable internet for everyone? Or perhaps you're heading abroad for a longer stay, like a student exchange program or a short-term work assignment overseeing a project? A Yoowifi router offers a fantastic solution for consistent, shared connectivity. It's ideal for keeping small groups online together or setting up a reliable internet hub for your extended stay.
stayConnected.rentRouter: Here's how to rent our router:
rentRouterSteps: Choose the country where you'll primarily use the router to ensure optimal performance.
Select your preferred plan—daily, monthly, or multi-country options—with a suitable data size (e.g., 50GB or 100GB)
Click “Next” to review and verify your order details.
Choose your delivery method—opt for home delivery or self-pickup.
Complete the checkout and payment process.
Once you receive the Yoowifi router, you'll find easy-to-follow setup instructions included in the package to get you connected quickly.
stayConnected.rentSimTitle: How to Get a Yoowifi SIM and eSIM
stayConnected.rentSimDec: Traveling solo and just need data on your phone? Got an eSIM-friendly device and love the idea of a purely digital setup? Or maybe you simply prefer the convenience of not carrying an extra gadget? If this sounds like your travel style, then a Yoowifi SIM or eSIM is your ideal connectivity solution.
stayConnected.rentSim: Here’s how to get your Yoowifi SIM or eSIM:
rentSimSteps: First, check if your mobile device is SIM or eSIM compatible and not SIM locked.
If compatible, proceed to download the Yoowifi app on your phone and register for an account.
Visit the "SIM/eSIM" section within the Yoowifi app.
Choose the country you'll be traveling to.
Select whether you prefer a physical SIM card or an eSIM.
Choose your preferred data plan, including the data size and the number of days you'll need it.
Proceed to checkout. Select your preferred delivery method for a physical SIM and place your order. For an eSIM, you'll receive a QR code instantly upon purchasing.
Setup instructions on how to activate your Yoowifi SIM or eSIM are provided within the app.
Once you receive your SIM or eSIM, you can activate it before you depart or when you arrive at your destination.
stayConnected.tipsTitle: Top Tips for Maximizing Yoowifi While Traveling
stayConnected.tipsDec: Want to make the most of your Yoowifi SIM/eSIM, pocket wifi, or router while traveling? Explore these practical tips below:

tipsList.title: Keep Your Devices Charged
tipsList.desc: Whether you're using your phone, tablet, or laptop, staying connected means keeping everything powered, including your Yoowifi pocket WiFi. Ensure all your devices are fully charged before you head out. For longer trips, consider packing a portable power bank so you’re never left without a connection when you need maps, messages, or that perfect photo upload.

tipsList.title: Monitor Data Usage (If Using a Capped Plan)
tipsList.desc: Don’t get caught off guard by data limits. Regularly check your data usage in the Yoowifi app (available on both iOS and Android devices) or directly on your Yoowifi pocket WiFi screen, which displays real-time data consumption. If you’re approaching your limit, easily top up via the Yoowifi app for uninterrupted connectivity.

tipsList.title: Turn Off Auto-Updates and Background Refresh
tipsList.desc: Prevent apps from consuming data in the background. Disable automatic app updates, social media auto-sync, and cloud backups unless connected to a free, secure network.

tipsList.title: Share Wifi Securely
tipsList.desc: If sharing your Yoowifi connection with friends or family, set a strong, unique password. This ensures unauthorized users don’t connect and drain your data. And since the password is displayed on the pocket WiFi screen, make sure it’s not left unattended where others can see it.

tipsList.title: Optimize Connection with Airplane Mode
tipsList.desc: When you only need WiFi, switch your device to airplane mode and then re-enable WiFi. This reduces battery drain and prevents your device from switching to costly mobile data.

outroParagraphs: Whether you need a SIM card for Thailand to make reservations at Bangkok´s popular restaurants, or a reliable pocket WiFi for Japan to share stunning Mount Fuji views on your social apps, Yoowifi has you covered with fast, secure, and reliable internet access. Forget the stress of searching for local options or fearing hefty roaming bills. With the convenience and flexibility of our portable WiFi solutions, you can stay connected no matter where you venture.
To ensure a smooth and hassle-free trip, order the Yoowifi SIM, eSIM, pocket WiFi, or router in advance. This way, they can arrive on time, ready for your journey.
Unlock seamless travel connectivity with Yoowifi today!

TermsDetailsMY.heading: Fair Usage Policy (FUP)
TermsDetailsMY.content:
6.1 'Unlimited' service is not always without limits. The limits are set with a Fair Usage Policy, which is a set of rules that impose a threshold on the amount of units (minutes, seconds, kilobytes etc.) used by users of a service. This is normally imposed on those services that are termed 'unlimited' which would initially mean that the user can use as many/much of the offered service as they want.

 6.2 Since abuse can happen, either intentional or non-intentional, the limit is imposed. As a limit of this abuse from one or a segment of the users, other users will be penalised. Also, the company offering the service loses as well. So, a fair usage policy stands as a means to avoid abuse and in the process protects the other consumers as well as the provider.

 6.3 Renters are advised to take note of the data limit capped by the Internet Service Provider (ISO Fair Usage Policy (FUP) in each country. The Internet Service Providers (ISP) implements a data limit to the user when a channel becomes overload and this limit varies in different countries, depending on their policy regulations.

 6.4 The user may experience either slow data speed, temporarily idle for a period of time, if the data usage exceeded the assigned limit The excess data will not incur additional cost on Customer's rental rates.

policyDetailsMY.heading: Privacy Policy
policyDetailsMY.content: This Data Protection Notice("Notice") sets out the basis which Yoowifi Malaysia Sdn. Bhd. ("we", "us", or "our") may collect, use, disclose or otherwise process personal data of our customers in accordance with the Personal Data Protection Act ("PDPA"). This Notice applies to personal data in our possession or under our control, including personal data in the possession of organisations which we have engaged to collect, use, disclose or process personal data for our purposes.

policyDetailsMY.heading: Personal Data
policyDetailsMY.content: 1. As used in this Notice: "customer" means an individual who (a) has contacted us through any means to find out more about any goods or services we provide, or (b) may, or has, entered into a contract with us for the supply of any goods or services by us; and "personal data"means data, whether true or not, about a customer who can be identified: (a) from that data; or (b) from that data and other information to which we have or are likely to have access. 1. Depending on the nature of your interaction with us, some examples of personal data which we may collect from you include name, residential address, email address, telephone number, nationality, gender, date of birth and photograph. 2. Other terms used in this Notice shall have the meanings given to them in the PDPA (where the context so permits).

policyDetailsMY.heading: Collection, Use and Disclosure Of Personal Data
We may disclose your personal data:
policyDetailsMY.content:
1. where such disclosure is required for performing obligations in the course of or in connection with our provision of the goods and services requested by you; or 

2. to third party service providers, agents and other organisations we have engaged to perform any of the functions with reference to the above mentioned purposes.

3. The purposes listed in the above clauses may continue to apply even in situations where your relationship with us (for example, pursuant to a contract) has been terminated or altered in any way, for a reasonable period thereafter (including, where applicable, a period to enable us to enforce our rights under a contract with you).

policyDetailsMY.heading: Relliance On The Legitimate Interests Exception
policyDetailsMY.content:
1. In compliance with the PDPA, we may collect, use or disclose your personal data without your consent for the legitimate interests of Yoowifi Malaysia Sdn. Bhd or another person. In relying on the legitimate interests exception of the PDPA, Yoowifi Malaysia Sdn. Bhd. will assess the likely adverse effects on the individual and determine that the legitimate interests outweigh any adverse effect 
2. In line with the legitimate interests' exception, we will collect, use or disclose your personal data for the following purposes: 
3. Fraud detection and prevention; 
4. Detection and prevention of misuse of services; 
5. Network analysis to prevent fraud and financial crime, and perform credit analysis; and 
6. Collection and use of personal data on company-issued devices to prevent data loss. 

The purposes listed in the above clause may continue to apply even in situations where your relationship with us (for example, pursuant to a contract) has been terminated or altered in any way, for a reasonable period thereafter.

policyDetailsMY.heading: Withdrawing Your Consent
policyDetailsMY.content:
1. The consent that you provide for the collection, use and disclosure of your personal data will remain valid until such time it is being withdrawn by you in writing. You may withdraw consent and request us to stop collecting, using and/or disclosing your personal data for any or all of the purposes listed above by submitting your request in writing or via email to our Data Protection Officer at the contact details provided below. 

2. Upon receipt of your written request to withdraw your consent, we may require reasonable time (depending on the complexity of the request and its impact on our relationship with you) for your request to be processed and for us to notify you of the consequences of us acceding to the same, including any legal consequences which may affect your rights and liabilities to us. In general, we shall seek to process your request within sixty (60) business days of receiving it 

3.  Whilst we respect your decision to withdraw your consent, please note that depending on the nature and scope of your request, we may not be in a position to continue providing our goods or services to you and we shall, in such circumstances, notify you before completing the processing of your request. Should you decide to cancel your withdrawal of consent, please inform us in writing in the manner described in clause 8 above. 

4. Please note that withdrawing consent does not affect our right to continue to collect, use and disclose personal data where such collection, use and disclose without consent is permitted or required under applicable laws.

policyDetailsMY.heading: Access To And Correction Of Personal Data
policyDetailsMY.content:
1. If you wish to make (a) an access request for access to a copy of the personal data which we hold about you or information about the ways in which we use or disclose your personal data, or (b) a correction request to correct or update any of your personal data which we hold about you, you may submit your request in writing or via email to our Data Protection Officer at the contact details provided below. 

2. Please note that a reasonable fee may be charged for an access request. If so, we will inform you of the fee before processing your request. 

3. We will respond to your request as soon as reasonably possible. In general, our response will be within sixty (60) business days. Should we not be able to respond to your request within thirty (30) days after receiving your request, we will inform you in writing within thirty (30) days of the time by which we will be able to respond to your request. If we are unable to provide you with any personal data or to make a correction requested by you, we shall generally inform you of the reasons why we are unable to do so (except where we are not required to do so under the PDPA).

policyDetailsMY.heading: Protection Of Personal Data
policyDetailsMY.content:
1. To safeguard your personal data from unauthorised access, collection, use, disclosure, copying, modification, disposal or similar risks, we have introduced appropriate administrative, physical and technical measures such as minimised collection of personal data, authentication and access controls (such as good password practices, need-to-basis for data disclosure, etc.), encryption of data, up-to-date antivirus protection, regular patching of operating system and other software, and usage of one time password(otp)/2 factor authentication (2fa)/multi-factor authentication (mfa) to secure access. 

2. You should be aware, however, that no method of transmission over the Internet or method of electronic storage is completely secure. While security cannot be guaranteed, we strive to protect the security of your information and are constantly reviewing and enhancing our information security measures.

policyDetailsMY.heading: Accuracy Of Personal Data
policyDetailsMY.content: We generally rely on personal data provided by you (or your authorised representative). In order to ensure that your personal data is current, complete and accurate, please update us if there are changes to your personal data by informing our Data Protection Officer in writing or via email at the contact details provided below.

policyDetailsMY.heading: Retention Of Personal Data
policyDetailsMY.content:
1. We may retain your personal data for as long as it is necessary to fulfil the purpose for which it was collected, or as required or permitted by applicable laws.

2. We will cease to retain your personal data, or remove the means by which the data can be associated with you, as soon as it is reasonable to assume that such retention no longer serves the purpose for which the personal data was collected, and is no longer necessary for legal or business purposes.

policyDetailsMY.heading: Transfers Of Personal Data Outside Of Malaysia
policyDetailsMY.content: We generally do not transfer your personal data to countries outside of Malaysia. However, if we do so, we will obtain your consent for the transfer to be made and we will take steps to ensure that your personal data continues to receive a standard of protection that is at least comparable to that provided under the PDPA.

policyDetailsMY.heading: Data Protection Officer
policyDetailsMY.content: You may contact our Data Protection Officer if you have any enquiries or feedback on our personal data protection policies and procedures, or if you wish to make any request, in the following manner: Contact No: +65 6100 9998 Email Address: hello@yoowifi.com.

policyDetailsMY.heading: Effect Of Notice And Changes To Notice
policyDetailsMY.content:
1. This Notice applies in conjunction with any other notices, contractual clauses and consent clauses that apply in relation to the collection, use and disclosure of your personal data by us.

2. We may revise this Notice from time to time without any prior notice. You may determine if any such revision has taken place by referring to the date on which this Notice was last updated. Your continued use of our services constitutes your acknowledgement and acceptance of such changes.
